name: money-platform
description: A modular monolith for small subscription software products.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@platform/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@platform/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@platform/web && npm run build --workspace=@platform/api
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=@platform/web && npm run check --workspace=@platform/api
